properties.name: Aden Creek Campsite
properties.description: At a big A frame Bridge over the creek, go east on a short side trail. The campsite is at a loop in the creek. There is another small bridge that takes you across the creek to the latrine. Campfire area has a backpacking table/bench.

properties.name: Bill Thomas Memorial Bridge Campsite
properties.description: West end of Thomas Bridge, take a side trail north for 100 yards. Campsite is up on a little ridge overlooking the Tyler Forks River. Campfire area with Table/bench.

properties.name: Catlin Creek Campsite
properties.description: Nice campsite overlooking marshy area. Take the NCT west to the Catlin Creek Bridge to get water. Campfire area has a backpacking table/bench. Register box on NCT at trail Junction.

properties.name: Clear Creek Campsite
properties.description: Campsite on a plateau overlooking Clear Creek. Campfire area has a backpacking table/bench. Long water trail going downhill to the creek.

properties.name: Copper Falls Backpacking Campsite
properties.description: Has big campfire area. Direct access to river for Water. Sandstone bluff on opposite side of river. Fee Campsites (see the Ranger Station) Wisconsin State Parks

properties.name: Drummond Lake Campground
properties.description: Nice town campground w/ showers (may need quarters) mile+ off the NCT. Nice town park with beach down from the campground. Town gas station has groceries for resupply. Sites can be reserved on the internet. Fee campsites. see: drummondlakecampground.com

properties.name: East Davis Lake Campsite
properties.description: Campsite on the shore of the lake. Campfire ring and seating. Campsite is about 50 yards down the trail from the lake.

properties.name: Erick Lake Campsite
properties.description: Nice wooded Campsite just a few feet uphill from the trail and lake. Good landing at lake to get water. Campfire area has a backpacking table/bench. Register box on NCT at trail Junction.

properties.name: Gold Mine West Campsite
properties.description: Side trail going south to the campsite. The Creek down near the trail junction is the water source for the campsite. Backpacker table and bench at the campfire area. Register box at trail Junction.

properties.name: Gordon Dam County Park
properties.description: Picnic Tables and Fire Rings. Fee Campsite. Please see Douglas County website for info.

properties.name: Highland Campsite
properties.description: Just off the NCT out in a pine woods near the Highland Town Hall. Water is from a building at the Town Hall. White blazed trail from the NCT to the water source. Campfire area has a backpacking table/bench.

properties.name: Jersett Creek Campsite
properties.description: On hill right after the NCT takes a steep ascent going up from the creek. So, getting water from the creek is a little more strenuous than most campsites. Campfire area has a backpacking table/bench. Register box on NCT at trail Junction.

properties.name: Leo Creek Campsite
properties.description: Backpacking table bench in campfire area. Overlooking a clear area. Campfire area has a backpacking table/bench. There are two other tent pads out near the junction of the NCT and side trail. Douglas County special camping permit required. Please see Douglas County website for info.

properties.name: Lucius Woods County Park
properties.description: Sites have a Picnic table and metal fire rings. Please see Douglas County website for info.

properties.name: Morris Pond Campsite
properties.description: 75-yard side trail going north from the NCT. Water source for the campsite is a creek that you cross. Nice grassy campsite with a table/bench overlooking the lake. It’s hard to get down to the lake from the campsite so use the creek.

properties.name: North Campground
properties.description: NCT uses Campground Road through the Campground. Picnic Tables and Fire Grates. Fee Campsites (see the Ranger Station) Wisconsin State Parks

properties.name: Pattison State Park Backpacking Sites
properties.description: Over a mile off of the NCT. Sites have picnic tables and metal fire rings. Fee campsite(stop at Ranger Station). Wisconsin State Parks

properties.description: Over a mile off of the NCT. Sites have picnic tables and metal fire rings. Fee campsite(stop at Ranger Station). Wisconsin State Parks

properties.name: Paul Schoch Campsite
properties.description: On small plateau. Campfire area + table/bench. Nearby creek has dam w/ pipe. Register box at trl junction. Dedicated in memory of Paul Schoch, a committed NCTA  volunteer, who passed away while backpacking in Wrangell-St. Elias National Park, Alaska 2007.

properties.name: Primitive Campsite
properties.description: Douglas County special camping permit required. Please see Douglas County website for info.

properties.name: Primitive Campsite
properties.description: Douglas County special camping permit required. Please see Douglas County website for info.

properties.name: Rovers Lake Campsite
properties.description: Nice Campsite on a hill on the north side of Rovers Lake. Take the NCT east from the campsite to get water from the lake. Campfire area has a backpacking table/bench. Register box on NCT at trail Junction.  Douglas County special camping permit required. Please see Douglas County website for info.

properties.name: Scott Rapids Campsite (St. Croix NSR)
properties.description: Grassy area with picnic table and metal fire ring. (St. Croix NSR)

properties.name: South Campground
properties.description: Picnic Tables and Fire Grates. Fee Campsites (see the Ranger Station) Wisconsin State Parks

properties.name: Spruce Point Campsite
properties.description: On a high point looking into the valley below.  Campfire area has a backpacking table/bench. Long water trail going downhill to the creek.  Douglas County special camping permit required. Please see Douglas County website for info.

properties.name: State Park Family Campground
properties.description: Sites have picnic tables and metal fire rings. Fee Campsite, Showers. Wisconsin State Parks

properties.name: Tilted Gabbro Campsite
properties.description: Next to the Potato River. In the campsite is a large tilted gabbro rock that was brought to this location by the glacier 11,000 years ago. Campfire area, backpacking table/bench. Register box on NCT at trail Junction.

properties.name: Two Lakes CG
properties.description: Take side trail .6 miles from NCT. Big Campground with 2 beaches and water craft rentals. Campsites have picnic tables and fire rings. Fee Campsite.

properties.name: Whiskey Creek Campsite
properties.description: Campsite up on a small hill. It has a campfire area with benches.

properties.name: Winneboujou Bluff Campsite
properties.description: Take old forest road east from the NCT 50-feet and the campsite is on the right. The Latrine is down a trail going to the left. Trail going west from NCT goes downhill .3 miles to a water source. Campfire area has a backpacking table/bench.
